label: Main
description: The gateway's built-in default agent — the one an inbound message lands on.
_why: Not an agent anybody authored: OpenClaw brings it, and an inbound Signal
message lands on it because it is the default and carries no routing rule.
Measured dormant — two sessions in three months, and the only tools it ever
called were memory_search and cron. mora02 itself never runs a turn on it:
notify uses `message send`, a CLI call with no model in it.
It is in the roster for one reason. An MCP server is registered GLOBALLY,
and an agent WITHOUT an explicit allow list receives every tool the gateway
has — including every MCP tool registered later. Until this list existed it
carried all of them, exec included, with the sandbox off, reachable by
active:false keeps it out of the Pilot's agent list. It is not a persona to
talk to; it is a letterbox that needs its lid held down.
manage_workspace:false because its workspace is the shared, hand-made one.
The rollout governs its tool surface and touches none of its files.
